text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sob sob sob... To not get a single one... 
it's just so sad, so very sad, sob sob...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, please don't take it so 
seriously. It's just a joke, a joke!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just knowing you did your best for my 
sake is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my resolve to become the 
star of the show has been renewed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Once I become the star and Paka Puchi gets 
super popular, you'd better win one for 
real next time, okay?
choice_data_list:
Absolutely. And I'll enshrine it on the 
kamidana

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, could you please refrain from doing 
that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
